actions.action: Move other plants at least 6 feet away to isolate this one
Check other plants' leaf undersides for similar bumps
Rub off bumps and white specks with an alcohol-dipped cotton swab, about 5 leaves a day until the whole plant is done
Spray insecticidal soap on both sides of all leaves and stems, out of direct sun, weekly for 4 weeks
Check the soil moisture every few days
Water until it drains once the top 2 inches are dry

reason: The answer correctly calls it a pest infestation plus relocation stress but names scale or mealybugs instead of thrips and doesn't blame the sun; its isolation, alcohol wipe and insecticidal soap plan matches what the poster did that worked, and nothing in it is likely to cause harm.
